channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE torna vereador inelegível por violência política de gênero pela primeira vez
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) declared a politician ineligible for the first time due to political violence against women, unanimously condemning councilman José Sebastião Rabello (Zezinho do Caminhão) of Nova Friburgo (RJ) for attacks against councilwoman Priscila Teixeira Pitta Muniz. The ruling followed an appeal by the Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office, overturning the TRE-RJ's view that there was insufficient proof of intent to silence based on gender. Rapporteur Minister Dias Toffoli emphasized that threats such as 'You will have to hit the woman. Hold her arms' constitute political gender-based violence, not mere rhetoric, and removed the councilman's parliamentary immunity.

item.title: Em meio à crise, embaixador da Argentina no Brasil retorna a Buenos Aires; Mauro Vieira se reúne com brasileiro
item.description: Argentina's ambassador to Brazil, Daniel Raimondi, returned to Buenos Aires after Brazil downgraded diplomatic relations with Argentina due to repeated attacks by President Javier Milei against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, whom Milei called 'corrupt', 'thief', and 'convicted'. The Argentine embassy in Brasília is now led by chargé d'affaires María Cortés. Chancellor Mauro Vieira met with Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Júlio Bitelli, who was recalled for consultations, and confirmed there is no timeline for his return as long as Milei continues his attacks, since the downgrade hinges on a change in Argentina's conduct.

item.title: Renan Santos: Pedi acareação com Flávio Bolsonaro, mas ele não quer contato conosco
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, stated he requested a confrontation with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after the latter joined the party, but said Bolsonaro refuses to maintain contact. Santos made the remarks at the Blockchain.Rio event in downtown Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Lula usa divulgação de dados de emprego para fazer propaganda do governo e reforçar crítica às bets
item.description: President Lula released the Rais employment data to highlight the government's advances in job creation while simultaneously criticizing excessive spending on sports betting (bets), linking the issue to fiscal and social responsibility. The remarks were made on the eve of the 2026 election campaign, aiming to strengthen the narrative of efficient governance and warn about the social risks associated with betting.

item.title: JHC diz a Lula e ao PSDB que vai disputar Senado e enfurece Lira em Alagoas
item.description: Former Maceió mayor João Henrique Caldas (JHC), from the PSDB, abandoned his bid for governor of Alagoas and announced he will run for one of the state’s two Senate seats. The decision was communicated to President Lula and the PSDB leadership but kept confidential among local allies. The shift angered House Speaker Arthur Lira, who had viewed JHC as a potential ally in Alagoas.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: TSE reestabelece filiação de Flávio após polêmica com Missão
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques ordered the immediate reinstatement of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the Liberal Party, nullifying an improper link with the Mission party. The decision responds to a request from the party and was announced on the Papo Antagonista program.

item.title: Ibovespa tem 8º pregão seguido de queda; entenda motivos
item.description: The Ibovespa recorded its eighth consecutive day of decline, closing at 167,100 points, driven by foreign capital outflows due to concerns over fiscal prospects, gross debt, and the 2026 electoral context. The downgrade of Brazil’s index to 'neutral' by JP Morgan heightened foreign investor attention to these risks, which were previously more of a domestic concern. Among major banks, Banco do Brasil led losses at -4.16%, while Santander rose 0.71%.

item.title: Flávio quer tropas em portos para combater “cocaína made in Brazil”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) government program proposes deploying Navy and Air Force special troops permanently in Brazilian ports and airports to combat cocaine trafficking, including the 'Muralha Brasileira' facial recognition system and over 1 million new surveillance cameras. The plan also calls for doubling federal public security investments and states that traffickers who resist will be arrested or killed. Bolsonaro criticizes the Lula government, claiming the Port of Santos has become one of the world's top cocaine exporters.

item.title: Em plano de governo, presidenciável do Democrata propõe imposto único
item.description: Veterinarian Wilson Grassi, the Democrata party's presidential candidate, unveiled his 'Brazil First' government plan, proposing a single tax on financial transactions, income tax exemption for those earning up to five minimum wages, elimination of payroll social security deductions, education funding tied to literacy exam results, and automatic housing financing for renters with a proven payment history. He also declared R$ 50 million in assets, all listed under a single category: 'Other assets and rights'.

item.title: Crise: Itamaraty voltou a discutir relação com Argentina nesta 5ª
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira held his fourth meeting with Julio Bitelli, the designated ambassador to Argentina, to assess the ongoing diplomatic crisis between Brazil and Argentina triggered by Argentine President Javier Milei's attacks on President Lula. The Itamaraty has decided to keep Bitelli in Brazil, downgrade bilateral relations, and demand the withdrawal of the Argentine ambassador in Brasília, following Milei's continued criticism despite Brazilian reprimands.

item.title: Programa de Flávio propõe jornada flexível de trabalho
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's 2027-2030 government program proposes greater flexibility in working hours, advocating 'negotiated over legislated' agreements between workers and companies, without mentioning the end of the 6×1 schedule. It includes measures to reduce formal labor costs, special contracts for young workers and those over 50 unemployed for over a year, and a national job bank to modernize labor intermediation. The plan also questions union influence in public policy, prioritizing direct worker interests.

item.title: Em plano, Flávio propõe reaproximação com EUA e reação a sanções
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, proposes diplomatic rapprochement with the United States and other trade partners to lift barriers and sanctions on Brazilian products, criticizing the ideological foreign policy of the Lula government. His government plan, 'Plan for Brazil to Win Backwardness,' includes axes such as economy, security, and state management, and will be filed with the TSE on Thursday (August 13). The document advocates a pragmatic diplomacy focused on mutual gain, reversing the estrangement from traditional partners like the U.S., Argentina, and Israel.

item.title: Pedido de vista trava R$ 2,3 bilhões do Fundo Eleitoral
item.description: The distribution of R$ 2.3 billion from the 2026 Electoral Fund is on hold due to a request for vista by Minister Estela Aranha of the TSE, delaying the judgment on how resources should be divided among parties based on their representation in the Chamber of Deputies. The amount corresponds to the share calculated according to party strength in the lower house.

item.title: Filiação fraudulenta de Flávio ao Missão incluiu uso de e-mail oficial e dados falsos como CPF 1234 e endereço em Bairro dos Milicianos
item.description: A report from the Missão party reveals that Flávio Bolsonaro’s fraudulent affiliation used his official Senate email, a falsified CPF (123456789), an invented address (Rua dos Bandidos, Bairro Miliciano), and an incorrect birth date. The TSE annulled the affiliation and restored his PL registration, ordering the Federal Police to investigate. Renan Santos, the Missão party’s presidential candidate, accused Flávio of cowardice and demanded a live confrontation, while Flávio claimed the episode was a systemic attempt to block his presidential bid.

item.title: O alívio de Motta com a reconciliação entre Lula e Alcolumbre
item.description: The rapprochement between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre has been celebrated by Chamber President Hugo Motta as a unblocking of the Executive’s agenda in Congress after months of tension since November 2023. Motta said he worked to facilitate dialogue but stressed that reconciliation depended solely on Lula and Alcolumbre. The normalized relations have enabled recent legislative progress for the federal government.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em 'valores inegociáveis' e defende reforma do judiciário em programa de governo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) unveiled his government program at a party convention, defending 'non-negotiable' values such as liberty, family, life from conception, private property, democracy, and freedom of expression and religion. The proposal includes a judicial reform targeting the STF, such as banning relatives of judges from serving in the same court, limiting monocratic decisions, and ending the STF’s original criminal jurisdiction over lawmakers to allow trial in lower courts, aiming to reduce judicial overreach and strengthen congressional authority.

item.title: Flávio propõe reformar Judiciário, classificar facções como narcoterroristas e prisões a la Bukele
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro proposes judicial reform, including ending the STF’s original criminal jurisdiction, limiting monociclic decisions, imposing a one-year quarantine for ministerial appointments, and increasing civil society participation in the CNJ and CNMP. He also seeks to classify criminal factions as narcoterrorist organizations, reduce the age of criminal responsibility, build Bukele-style maximum-security prisons, and abolish presidential re-election via a constitutional amendment.

item.title: Ficha de filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão registrou 'rua dos bandidos' como endereço do senador
item.description: The membership form of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for the Missão party listed a fictional address: 'Rua Dos Bandidos, nº 666, Bairro Miliciano', sparking controversy. Despite this, his affiliation with the PL party was reinstated by a decision from TSE Minister Kassio Nunes Marques on Thursday (13). The incident unfolds during the 2026 presidential campaign, in which the senator is a candidate.

item.title: As 6 celebridades mais ricas que vão disputar cargos públicos nas eleições de 2026
item.description: In the 2026 elections, six celebrities are the wealthiest among candidates, according to TSE data. Silvia Abravanel leads with R$ 47.5 million in declared assets, followed by Sarah Poncio (R$ 4.5 million), Humberto Martins (R$ 3.6 million), and Vivian Amorim. The others were not detailed in the provided excerpt. The list highlights the growing trend of entertainers and influencers entering Brazilian politics.

item.title: TSE mantém multa à Quaest por não identificar bairro em pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) upheld, by majority, a R$ 53,000 fine imposed on polling institute Quaest for failing to identify neighborhoods in an electoral survey conducted in Teresina (PI) during the 2024 municipal elections. The Court ruled that citing IBGE census sectors does not substitute the requirement under Resolution 23.600/2019 to specify the neighborhood or area of data collection, which is necessary to ensure geographic dispersion and prevent potential manipulation. Relator Minister Antonio Carlos Ferreira was joined by Ministers André Mendonça, Dias Toffoli, and Nunes Marques, while Ministers Floriano de Azevedo Marques, Villas Bôas Cueva, and Estela Aranha dissented, arguing that census sectors provide sufficient geographic precision.

item.title: Kalil diz que é 'invenção' briga com Lula: 'Só não quis compor com o PT'
item.description: Alexandre Kalil (PDT), Minas Gerais gubernatorial candidate, denied having broken with President Lula, claiming the alleged feud was an 'invention' by third parties and that he simply chose not to form an electoral alliance with the PT. He noted he voted for Lula for the first time in 2022, despite supporting Aécio Neves in 2015, and said he holds no grudges against the tucano, despite past criticisms. Kalil also defended keeping Cemig under public control, questioned the need to privatize Copasa due to legal insecurity, and stated his 2026 presidential vote will remain secret.

item.title: “Neutro é shampoo de bebê”, diz Renan Filho
item.description: Senator Renan Filho (MDB) denied being neutral in the presidential race and reaffirmed his alliance with President Lula (PT) following a meeting at the Palácio da Alvorada. In a social media post, he used the phrase 'Neutral is baby shampoo' to criticize the idea of political impartiality. The Alagoas gubernatorial candidate stated he has already made his support for the president clear.

item.title: ‘Não somos golpistas’, afirma ex-comandante que disse não a Bolsonaro
item.description: Air Lieutenant Brigadier Carlos de Almeida Baptista Júnior, former commander of the Brazilian Air Force, stated he refused to support a coup after the 2022 elections despite pressure from Bolsonaro’s allies. He denounced defamation campaigns led by figures such as General Braga Netto and reserve military members, who labeled him a 'watermelon' for his constitutional stance. Two years later, his testimony before the STF contributed to the imprisonment of Bolsonaro and allies, reinforcing his role in defending democracy.

item.title: Daniela Lima: Flávio no Missão robustece tese de sistema eleitoral falho
item.description: According to columnist Daniela Lima, Flávio Bolsonaro’s affiliation with the Missão party reinforces the thesis that Brazil’s electoral system is porous or flawed, as it allows figures linked to Bolsonarism to quickly access party structures, circumventing institutional barriers. This highlights weaknesses in party affiliation regulations and electoral process transparency.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sufre problemas para inscribir su candidatura presidencial al aparecer en un partido distinto al suyo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is facing difficulties in officially registering his presidential candidacy because the Superior Electoral Court's system incorrectly shows him as affiliated with a different party. With only two days left before the registration deadline, his team is working to correct the issue. The TSE president ruled out a cyberattack and launched an investigation.

item.title: OEA anuncia que irá observar as eleições do Brasil
item.description: The OEA will deploy a mission to observe Brazil's 2026 elections, with presence confirmed for the first round on October 4 and potentially the second round on October 25. The mission will be led by José Miguel Insulza, former OEA Secretary-General, marking the organization's fifth election observation in Brazil since 2018. In 2022, the OEA praised the order, normality, and effectiveness of Brazil's electronic voting machines, as well as the TSE's work amid polarization and disinformation.

item.title: Lula avalia timing para indicar Messias ao STF após reaproximação com Alcolumbre
item.description: President Lula is assessing the timing for nominating Jorge Messias to the Federal Supreme Court, following a rapprochement with Senator Davi Alcolumbre, which has reopened discussions on STF succession. While the nomination is seen as possible this year, Lula has not yet decided when to submit the name to the Senate. The move reflects broader political efforts to secure congressional support.

item.title: Cleitinho diz que perdeu palanque com indefinição sobre candidatura ao governo de Minas Gerais
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) acknowledged that the delay in confirming his candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais, influenced by mourning his brother's death, weakened his alliances and allowed the PL to nominate Flávio Roscoe. He stated he will now build a campaign based on direct voter mobilization, not a broad party platform, and intends to engage with whoever wins the presidential election, having already expressed support for Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Renan Filho manda recado a adversários em foto com Lula: ‘Neutro é shampoo de bebê’
item.description: Senator and former Transport Minister Renan Filho (MDB) strengthened his alliance with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in a meeting at the Palácio da Alvorada, confirming Lula’s 'total support' for his 2026 gubernatorial bid in Alagoas and pledging his backing for Lula’s re-election, using the phrase 'Neutral is baby shampoo!' to reject neutrality. The meeting also included an invitation to joint electoral guide recordings. This comes as former Maceió mayor JHC (PSDB) signals a potential shift to a Senate race, weakening the opposition to Renan Filho’s gubernatorial campaign.

item.title: Veja quando será o primeiro debate para presidente em 2026
item.description: The first presidential debate for the 2026 elections is scheduled for August 23, Sunday, at 8:00 p.m., on TV Band, in partnership with TV Cultura, Jovem Pan, and TV Gazeta. The event will take place at Band’s studios in São Paulo and will be streamed on YouTube, Bandplay, the network’s website, and Bandeirantes and BandNews FM radio. Although the date is confirmed, Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) have not yet confirmed attendance, with Lula’s campaign citing a scheduling conflict with the official launch of his candidacy in São Bernardo do Campo.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro volta a ser filiado ao PL; TSE cancelou vínculo com o Missão
item.description: The TSE reinstated Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the Liberal Party (PL) after confirming that his alleged affiliation with the Mission Party resulted from improper use of credentials, not hacking. Minister Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the removal of the Mission Party link from his partisan history and enabled the PL to file Flávio's presidential candidacy, with the deadline on August 15. The Mission Party claims it was a victim of fraudulent affiliation attempts and tried to cancel the registration, but the TSE rejected the request.

item.title: Sistema do TSE volta a mostrar Flávio Bolsonaro como filiado ao PL
item.description: The TSE restored Flávio Bolsonaro's regular affiliation with the PL party, annulling an erroneous registration with the Missão party that was made without his authorization. The change removes the obstacle to registering his presidential candidacy, with the deadline ending this Saturday (15/8). TSE President Minister Nunes Marques ordered the correction after finding evidence that the Missão registration did not reflect the senator's will.

item.title: Estoque de empregos formais no Brasil atinge 62 milhões no 1º semestre
item.description: Brazil's formal job stock reached 62.8 million in the first half of 2026, a 19.1% increase from January 2023. The services sector led growth with 8.45 million new formal jobs, followed by commerce and industry. Job growth was strongest among women (25%) and in the public sector, which rose from 9.25 million to 14.31 million formal links.

item.title: Nunes Marques vota contra pedido do PT para recalcular fundo eleitoral, e julgamento é suspenso
item.description: TSE rapporteur Kassio Nunes Marques voted against the PT's request to recalculate the electoral fund based on 69 deputies, arguing that the 68-deputy bench resulting from the 2022 vote retotalization in Alagoas — completed in May 2026 — should be used as the reference for the 2026 fund calculation. Following his vote, Minister Estela Aranha requested a delay (vista) to analyze the effects of a suspension by Minister Dias Toffoli on the retotalization process. The dispute centers on whether the retotalization following the annulment of João Catunda's (PP) diploma and the subsequent seating of Nivaldo Albuquerque Neto (Republicanos) is valid for determining the proportional distribution of the electoral fund.

item.title: Nikolas defende Gaspar e diz que vice fortalece chapa de Flávio
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) defended Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as the vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) ticket, stating he strengthens the ticket. Nikolas highlighted Gaspar's work in public security and the INSS CPI during a press briefing in the Chamber last Wednesday, the 12th.

item.title: Edmundo declara R$ 16 milhões em bens à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Former footballer Edmundo, a federal deputy candidate for the PSDB, declared R$16 million in assets to the Electoral Court. Of this total, R$3.85 million is invested in 147,300 Petrobras shares. His campaign slogan focuses on acting in Brasília to defend Vasco da Gama, the club he won championships with.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda restabelecer filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao PL e determina investigação
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques ordered the immediate reinstatement of Flávio Bolsonaro’s affiliation with the Liberal Party (PL) and the removal of his irregular affiliation with the Mission Party. He also mandated the release of the system for the PL’s candidacy registration, due by August 15 at 7 PM, and directed the Federal Police to open an investigation into the fraudulent affiliation, which the TSE attributes to misuse of credentials, not a system hack.

item.title: Nunes Marques cancela filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão e mantém senador no PL
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques annulled the unauthorized affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro with the Mission party and restored his registration with the PL. The Mission affiliation had blocked his 2022 presidential candidacy registration. The minister also ordered the preservation of system access logs and referred the case to the Federal Police for investigation into potential electoral fraud.

item.title: Com presença de Lula, Ministério do Trabalho faz evento para anunciar saldo de empregos gerados no mandato do petista
item.description: The Ministry of Labor announced that 10.1 million jobs were created between January 2023 and June 2026 during Lula’s third term, surpassing the 8 million figure cited in his own government program. The event, attended by President Lula, marked the launch of bimonthly RAIS data releases, previously annual. The figures were released three days before the official start of the 2026 election campaign.

item.title: TSE condena vereador que xingou colega de “vagabunda” e “escrota”
item.description: The TSE unanimously convicted councilman José Sebastião Rabello (Zezinho do Caminhão) for gender-based political violence against councilwoman Priscila Pitta, imposing a one-year prison sentence replaced by community service, suspension of political rights, and eight years of ineligibility. The ruling confirms that terms like 'slut' and 'whore' constitute gender discrimination aimed at hindering the full exercise of a female mandate.

item.title: Após disputa com Tarcísio, Fazenda autoriza crédito de R$ 5,45 bilhões
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas' government secured approval from the Ministry of Finance for a R$ 5.45 billion loan from Banco do Brasil to fund infrastructure and urban mobility projects in São Paulo. The authorization followed political tensions with the federal government and was signed by Finance Minister Dario Durigan. The funds aim to advance key development initiatives in the state.

item.title: Endereço atribuído a Flávio Bolsonaro na filiação ao Missão foi 'Rua dos Bandidos' e 'Bairro dos Milicianos'
item.description: A document from the Missão party shows that Flávio Bolsonaro was fraudulently affiliated with the party using a fictitious address ('Rua Dos Bandidos, n° 666, Bairro Miliciano') by an unidentified third party who misused the party’s own credentials. Flávio’s campaign claims this blocks his PL presidential candidacy registration, while Missão alleges to have proof someone accessed his email and confirmed the affiliation. The TSE ruled out a hacker attack, stating the affiliation resulted from improper use of the party’s tools by someone with legitimate access to its credentials.

item.title: TSE decide que pesquisas devem indicar bairro, e não setor censitário do IBGE
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ruled 4-3 that electoral research institutes must disclose the neighborhood, not the IBGE census sector, where interviews were conducted, prioritizing transparency over technical precision for voter understanding. The decision overturned a fine imposed by the Piauí Regional Electoral Court on Quaest for failing to disclose neighborhoods in a 2024 poll, setting future standards for electoral research in Brazil.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda restabelecer filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao PL após troca por Missão
item.description: TSE Minister Nunes Marques ordered the immediate reinstatement of Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the PL party after he claimed his transfer to the Mission party was made without his authorization. The change had been recorded in the Electoral Justice system, sparking controversy. The ruling aims to correct what is alleged to be an unauthorized action.

item.title: TSE cassa ex-vereador por violência de gênero após humilhar colega em comissão
item.description: The TSE unanimously removed former Nova Friburgo councilman José Sebastião Rabello (Zezinho do Caminhão) from office for political gender violence, after he humiliated a female colleague in a committee meeting. The ruling was based on evidence of discriminatory and hostile conduct.

item.title: EUA negam plano de Rubio para impedir reeleição de Lula
item.description: The U.S. State Department denied having any plan to prevent President Lula’s potential re-election, stating it will respect any democratically elected government in Brazil. The statement came after a report suggested Lula’s team believed Secretary of State Marco Rubio was involved in such efforts. The U.S. emphasized its commitment to respecting Brazilian sovereignty and electoral processes.

item.title: Nunes Marques determina que Flávio Bolsonaro volte ao PL e abre investigação
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the immediate return of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to the Liberal Party (PL), nullifying his affiliation with Partido Missão, ruling that the transfer did not reflect his will. He also mandated a Federal Police investigation into the alleged unauthorized filiation and opened the Candex system for Bolsonaro’s candidacy registration, with the deadline set for Saturday, the 15th.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Missão: entenda como funciona a filiação aos partidos no TSE e como teria ocorrido a fraude
item.description: The TSE found that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's party affiliation change to Missão was made improperly using credentials of a Missão party representative, constituting improper access use, not system intrusion. The incident temporarily blocked his presidential candidacy registration with PL due to dual affiliation prohibition, but the TSE ordered immediate reinstatement of his PL affiliation and allowed candidacy registration.

item.title: Nunes Marques acolhe petição de Flávio Bolsonaro, que está de volta ao PL
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques granted a petition from Flávio Bolsonaro’s lawyers to restore his membership in the Liberal Party (PL), ending the attempt to affiliate him with Renan Santos’ Missão party. The ruling confirms Flávio Bolsonaro’s return to the PL, his father’s party, following an internal dispute over his affiliation. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: PF vai abrir inquérito para apurar filiação indevida de Flávio Bolsonaro ao partido Missão
item.description: The Federal Police will open an investigation into the improper affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) to the Mission party, which occurred in the early hours of August 12-13, nullifying his PL affiliation and blocking his presidential candidacy registration with the TSE. The PL has requested deregistration and preservation of electronic logs to identify perpetrators, while the Mission party claims to be a victim of fraud and is cooperating with authorities.
